title: Multiple IDAT chunks share one compressed stream
summary: Concatenate the data fields of all IDAT chunks in order to form a single zlib stream.
applies: PNG specification and standalone PNG images
detail: A chunk boundary can fall inside DEFLATE data. Starting decompression at the second IDAT can fail.
boundary: Concatenate only the Data fields. Length, type, and CRC are part of the enclosing chunks. This rule describes IDAT in static images.
relevance: Explain the phenomenon that an image has multiple data blocks and a single block cannot be decompressed independently.
